title: Panel Demo
description: A Panel app with sidebar controls and a live Bokeh plot.
usage:
## Controls

- **Waveform**: choose sine, cosine, or a damped sine.
- **Amplitude**, **Frequency**, and **Phase**: shape the plotted curve.

## Theme

The manager passes the current light / dark theme to Panel when the server starts. Use **Reload** after changing the manager theme.

> Tip: project documentation opens in its own window, so you can keep the app open while reading it.
